skills.summary: A CSS 3D book slides in, its cover swings open at a click, the camera pushes into the page and a white flash cuts to a photo.

skills.code_name: Substring slice typing with pop-in chip
skills.summary: The address in a browser window is replaced letter by letter with a custom domain, then a green "connected" chip pops in at the corner.

skills.visual_name: AI brain scan with verdict card
skills.summary: A dark scanning window tilts up, the camera starts tight on a glowing brain with callouts, then the view jumps to a result card and pulls back.

skills.code_name: Frame sequence swap with spring verdict
skills.summary: A post card sits beside a dark panel that plays a scan animation and then springs into a green 'good to go' verdict with three scores, with a purple sticker tilting in on the corner.
Dark glowing pills with a green status dot reading Approved or Live slam onto a wall of video covers one after another, each starting 1.8x large and a few degrees off, then settling.
A frosted-glass pill rises in with a row of six overlapping avatars that pop in one by one beside a two-line label.

skills.code_name: Count up, snap to short form
skills.summary: A brand mark above a 260px number that counts up, snaps to its short form in violet with a pop, then the next brand replaces it.

skills.visual_name: Dark blueprint grid with drifting purple glow
skills.summary: A near-black field with a faint purple 80px grid creeping diagonally, a large blurred purple ellipse wandering behind it, and a dark vignette on the edges; it sits behind every scene of a video.
Three rows of blurred post thumbnails streak left at different speeds while two outlined arrows keep moving to the right.

skills.visual_name: Book, title and buy-button end card
skills.summary: Floating book on the left, serif title and yellow shop button on the right, cursor click, a closing line, fade to black.
A chrome badge hops up and down on decaying bounces over a shrinking and fading shadow, tilting side to side, while a bold dark word pops in next to it.

skills.code_name: Eased fade of a dark label
skills.summary: A small dark translucent rounded label with white bracketed text fades in centred under the scene's main object.

skills.code_name: Perspective rotate with slow camera zoom
skills.summary: A browser window with an address bar flies in from the right, rotated in 3D, flattens to face the viewer and then slowly zooms into its page before blurring away.

skills.visual_name: Browser window with focal camera zoom
skills.summary: A browser window holding a dashboard page, with a virtual camera that eases into one area of the page, then slides across to another, while status pills pop in beside it.
A dark browser window with a URL bar and a dashboard inside rises from below the bottom edge into the lower half of the frame with a very strong ease-out and a small scale-up.

skills.visual_name: Project popup with slider and launch
skills.code_name: Spring-in card with eased slider fill
skills.summary: A white popup card springs in with a green toggle, three fields and a budget slider that fills to 68 percent, then a cursor presses the blue launch button and the card fades away.

skills.visual_name: Bottom caption with word-by-word reveal and one highlighted word
skills.summary: A centred 40px caption at the bottom of the frame writes itself word by word across the length of the spoken line, with one chosen word bold and lilac, then fades out .4s after the line ends.

skills.visual_name: Three case cards with count-up numbers
skills.summary: Three dark cards rise from below one after another, tilted a few degrees outward and levelling out, each with a brand header and a big number counting up from zero.
Four dark pill chips with gold initial avatars pop up left to right, 0.22s apart, over the lower third of a photo.

skills.code_name: Numbered rail with active-label swap and full-width progress bar
skills.summary: A small uppercase row of chapter numbers at the top left lights the current one and shows only its name, while a thin gradient line along the bottom edge grows across the whole video.

skills.visual_name: Chart card wipes in with a big counting total
skills.summary: An analytics page whips up from below and dims, the line chart lifts out of it to the centre and draws left to right as a 150px total above it counts up from zero.

skills.visual_name: Check chip trio settling in a row
skills.code_name: Spring scale-in chips that settle from a stack into a row
skills.summary: Three dark pill chips with green ticks pop in one at a time on the spoken points; the first starts under a big word and then slides into the row with the other two.
Three huge one-word steps slide in from the left through a blur, each with a violet check dot that springs in, then a sentence builds below.

skills.visual_name: Chrome logo spin, rise and rings
skills.summary: A chrome logo mark turns a full rotation while rising and shrinking up the frame, with three thin violet rings expanding behind it.

skills.code_name: Blur resolve, spring button, cursor click
skills.summary: On black, a chrome wordmark resolves out of an 18px blur, a blue pill button rises under it, a cursor clicks it, a URL pill types out and a faint tagline fades in before the whole card fades out.
After a button click a purple circle grows from the button, slowly then fast on a cubic ease-in, until it floods the whole frame, and the next scene opens on the same colour.

skills.code_name: Radial burst with gravity and fade
skills.summary: 26 small blue, yellow, pink, cyan and green dots and squares burst out from the middle of the frame, spin, drop and fade away.

skills.visual_name: Cover orbit ring around a title
skills.summary: A 190px title snaps in from 140 percent through a blur while twelve small video covers fly out from the centre and settle into a slowly rotating ellipse around it.
A 15x9 wall of vertical covers pulls back from a 3.2x crop behind a glass card whose counter runs to a big figure while a line chart draws.

skills.visual_name: Cover wall pull-back from a tight crop
skills.summary: A grid of video covers starts at 3.2x so one tile fills the screen, pulls back to the whole wall tilted 16 degrees, approval stamps slam on, a title rises, and the wall whips upward out of frame.

skills.visual_name: Kinetic line with covers between the words, then zoom-through
skills.summary: A three-word headline builds on beats with a video cover popping in between the words, covers scatter around it, then the whole line scales 7.5x around the second cover until the cover fills the frame.
Fourteen vertical covers on a 3D ring spin up toward the camera with category pills, then the front cover rushes the lens into a white flash.
Forty-eight small portrait tiles spiral in from one spot above the centre and settle into a staggered grid, each landing at a slightly different moment.

skills.code_name: Spring float, red cross, blurred drop
skills.summary: A skewed paper document floats up, gets a red cross stamped on it as it turns grey, then falls away blurred behind a white flash.

skills.visual_name: CTA button click with typed address
skills.code_name: Spring button, press-scale and brightness flash, typed pill underneath
skills.summary: A big indigo "Get started" button springs up, a cursor clicks it, the button dips and flashes brighter, and the web address types itself into a pill beneath.
A black pill CTA pops in with overshoot, a big cursor clicks it with a ripple, and the button swells away.
A white arrow cursor eases onto a blue pill button, shrinks slightly on the click and releases a blue ring that grows and fades as the button dips.
An arrow cursor eases along keyframed points onto a button, dips to 82% on the click and a gold ring expands from it.
A near-black frame with an orange and pink glow at the bottom, a white sentence arriving word by word with a cursor drifting under it, then a larger line ending in a tiny card that falls out.

skills.code_name: Scrolling grid, rocking conic beam and drifting glow
skills.summary: A near-black stage with a fine 96px grid that scrolls diagonally, a blurred indigo light beam that rocks slowly and an indigo glow that wanders.
A near-black purple stage opens as a growing circle from an off-centre point over a light scene, and later closes back to the centre.

skills.visual_name: Dashboard cards lifting out of the page
skills.summary: A dashboard pushes in from depth, then its four stat cards lift off the page one per half beat on a spring, enlarged and tilted into a row above it while the page dims, and the views chart lifts to the centre and draws left to right.

skills.visual_name: Dashboard window fly-in with camera pan
skills.summary: A dark browser window flies in in 3D, a virtual camera pans and zooms across its screen capture, the cursor clicks a button, then the window zooms through the lens.

skills.code_name: Pixel canvas, Bayer-dithered sky, mesa parallax, scripted jumps on voiceover word times
skills.summary: The dino-game video, 9:16 and 16:9, on a pixel desert sunset: the product is a silhouette dino, a bad launch is the cactus; it crashes and restarts, then runs white at 2x through YourBrand into the chrome monogram and a black end card.

skills.visual_name: Dino runner: game over, then the endless run
skills.code_name: Pixel canvas, scripted jumps on voiceover word times
skills.summary: A video, 9:16 and 16:9, in the look of the offline dino game: the brand is the dino, obstacles are cacti, it hits one and restarts again and again, then runs at 2x through YourBrand, hits the chrome monogram and cuts to a black end card with the chrome logo.
Three 120px-blurred orbs (gold-brown, navy, oxblood) drift on slow sine paths on near-black; the mood decides which is at full strength.

skills.visual_name: Two dashboard panels with a money counter
skills.summary: Two dashboard panels slide in from opposite sides, tilted a few degrees the opposite way, and a big dollar figure counts up beneath them.

skills.code_name: ScaleX red bar and tinted link chip
skills.summary: A dark email composer tilts in from the right; its link is struck through by a red bar drawing left to right while its background goes red, then it swells and blurs away.

skills.code_name: RotateY spring mark, blur-in wordmark, fading address
skills.summary: A round mark spins in a full turn above a wordmark that scales down from 120% out of a blur, a shine crosses it, the web address fades up underneath, then everything fades to the stage.

skills.visual_name: End card with wordmark slam and typed URL
skills.summary: On a purple radial field the wordmark drops in from 150 percent with a 20px shake and a white flash, the URL types itself out with a blinking caret, a one-line call to action fades up, and the whole frame fades to black.
A column of post cards accelerates upward off the screen, blurring to 22px mid-move, with a spinning refresh icon above and a black word over it.
Small portrait cards and a larger room photo float into a dark layout with a soft shadow and a gold PHOTO caption fading in below.

skills.visual_name: Form walkthrough with a camera that follows the action
skills.code_name: Focus-point push-in, before/after screens, scripted cursor
skills.summary: A browser window tours form steps: camera pushes in on the field, cursor clicks and types, page scrolls to Continue, next step glides in.
Two lines of giant black type slam in from 135 percent with a 6px shake while two rows of blurred thumbnails drift under them.
Hard cuts every 3 beats between full-frame colour fields, each with a 560px number that counts up, punches in from 118 percent and runs off the right edge, beside a small brand label that slides in.

skills.code_name: Eo5 count with accent colour flip beside a phone
skills.summary: A 210px white number runs from 0 to 1,000,000 under a two-line headline, slowing hard at the end and turning lavender, with a small caption fading in and a phone leaning in on the right.
A dark frosted-glass card with a gold kicker, bold serif title and grey detail line scales up from 78% with an overshoot over a photo, then shrinks away.

skills.code_name: Eo5 count-up in a frosted card with tabular numerals
skills.summary: A small frosted card slides in and its number counts from 0 to 1,000,000 with a sharp ease-out, turning indigo when it lands.

skills.visual_name: Gold and silver metallic title lockup
skills.summary: Gold GOLDEN TITLE over silver SILVER LANE in chrome slab letters with hard drop shadows, script author name above and kicker line, a gloss band sliding over it.
A horizontal rail fills with gold as four serif years with captions pop on it, then a headline and photo land beneath.

skills.visual_name: Graded photo backdrop with slow zoom
skills.summary: Full-bleed photos cross-dissolve over 0.45s, each slowly zooming from 100% to 112%, graded warm and darkened toward the bottom.
A giant blue to cyan number counts from 0 up to 1,000,000,000+ in about a second, a small label fades under it, and two white cards with a logo and a view count tilt in on the left and right.
A giant orange to violet gradient word sweeps right to left across a white frame, blurring to 10px at its fastest.

skills.visual_name: Grain, vignette and fade to black
skills.summary: Fine SVG noise blended at 7% over a vignetted frame, which darkens to black over the last 0.6s.
A handwritten red note wipes on from the left and a curved hand-drawn arrow traces itself to point at a button.
A row of polaroid prints hangs from a thin string across the top, slides in from the right and drifts left, each swinging on its own pivot, with a large headline blurring in below.

skills.visual_name: White flash on a hard cut
skills.summary: A full-frame white layer jumps to 55 percent opacity on the first frame of each cut and drains linearly to zero in 0.12 seconds, so a straight cut between flat colour fields reads as a hit.
A method for putting real product screens in a video: headless Chrome at 2x for each section, plus a numbered PNG sequence of a running interaction.
Three 9:16 frames, hooks A, B and C, each a different two-line opening and card, with the next scene starting at a different time.

skills.code_name: Lerp path chip, window swap and row highlight
skills.summary: After a form is sent, a message chip lifts off the form, flies across to a second window, the inbox, where the new row lights up and a "New inquiry" badge pops.

skills.code_name: Clamped focus-and-zoom camera inside a laptop screen
skills.summary: A dark laptop frame shows a tall web page; a virtual camera scrolls it down to a section and zooms in, while a phone springs up beside it and a callout names the section.

skills.code_name: Beat-synced cut with punch zoom and active pill
skills.summary: A browser window cuts between six page layouts on successive beats while a pill bar below lights the matching name and the window punches in a little on each cut.

skills.code_name: Panel groups pushing through on translateX with blur
skills.summary: Each option is a full panel (huge name, small label, laptop and phone) that pushes in from the right and out to the left, one per spoken name, like frames on a strip.
A black LED-panel field of dots lit by a slowly spinning rainbow, with white words and a logo popping in on top.

skills.code_name: Blurred radial orbs drifting on a dot grid
skills.summary: A pale grey stage with a faint dot grid and four soft blurred colour blobs (indigo, blue, pink, slate) that drift slowly, under a very light dark vignette.
A thick blue line with a fading blue fill under it grows from the left edge across the frame, curving up to the right.
A logo mark pops in, the domain builds letter by letter, then a name and tagline fade up on a pastel ground.
A wordmark fades up out of a 10px blur while shrinking from 125 percent, flickering through random horizontal slices for the first half second, with a tagline sliding in under it.

skills.visual_name: Big number between two counter-scrolling logo rows
skills.summary: A 270px number counts up to 10,000+ in the middle while two rows of client logos run in opposite directions above and below it, with a small label fading in underneath.
A white diagonal highlight travels once across a chrome logo, clipped to the logo shape with screen blending.

skills.visual_name: Logo slam with shake and spark burst
skills.summary: On the beat a wordmark slams in from 170 percent with a hard 26px shake, a white flash and 26 sparks bursting outward, then zooms through the screen at the end.

skills.visual_name: Long page jump-scroll with motion blur
skills.summary: A tall page screenshot glides between section tops in short eased scrolls, blurred by speed, in a browser window.

skills.code_name: Words sliding up out of an overflow-hidden line
skills.summary: A left-aligned headline whose words slide up into view from beneath the bottom edge of their own line, each on its spoken word, then slide back up and out.

skills.visual_name: Eighth-note flash cuts with outlined giant word
skills.summary: Five hard cuts at eighth-note spacing, each a tall video cover over a 330px outlined word that slides in 60px, with a label pill under it; the first cut shrinks from 2.4x as if arriving from the previous zoom.
Five dark step boxes in a row light up one by one under a headline, a glowing wire grows between each pair and a white spark runs along it.
Two white notification cards with a dark app icon, a title, a line of text and a row of overlapping avatars rise into a loose stack with opposite tilts.
The same scene laid out at four aspect ratios side by side: headline, card and chips re-anchor by a few formulas.

skills.code_name: Three blurred circles on slow sine drift
skills.summary: Three huge blurred pastel circles drift slowly on a pale ground, behind everything in a light video.
A white card with an avatar, a name, a count line and a payment row springs in; a green check circle then pops in and the payment status fades up to solid green.
A browser window swings in rotated 22 degrees around its vertical axis, opacity rising, then keeps easing flat while the camera pushes into the page and a pill pops in.

skills.visual_name: Phone beside browser with synced screens
skills.summary: A phone rises in next to a browser window and its screens crossfade in step with the page being scrolled.
A dark phone with a video on its screen drops from above the frame and bounces once into place, with a sentence building word by word beneath it.

skills.code_name: Six phones springing into a rotated fan, staggered
skills.summary: Six phones rise from below and spring out into a fan, rotated up to 17 degrees either side of the middle, with the centre ones in front, beside a two-line headline.
A tilted row of seven phones springs up from the middle outward while Syncing spinners flip to green Synced ticks.

skills.visual_name: Phone mockup spring rise with tilt
skills.code_name: Spring translate and rotate from below
skills.summary: A big phone rises from 200px below with an 8 degree tilt and springs upright to a 3 degree lean, beside a two-line headline, while a social chip pops next to it.

skills.code_name: Staggered rise with bob and popping pills
skills.summary: Five phones rise from below into a row, each 0.06s after the last, and float up and down out of step while a row of four coloured platform pills and a dark chip pop in above them.
An analytics phone flanked by two video phones with view pills counting up to 1M and 4M, a Big win tag and a highlight frame.
Four white icon tiles fly up from a row of phones, tumbling level as they spring into place, each getting a green tick.

skills.visual_name: Typed prompt box with send click
skills.summary: A glowing prompt box types a sentence on an eased curve, a cursor slides to the send button and clicks, then the box swells and blurs away.
A tall rounded video card with a handle and caption bottom left, a like, comment, save and share rail on the right, and a big red heart that pops in beside it.
Eight app screens stack in the centre, then fan out into two tilted wings left and right while a two-line headline blurs in between them.

skills.code_name: Active dash stretch and text swap
skills.summary: A left sidebar of eyebrow, big title and description swaps text per section, with a list whose active item gets a stretched dash.
A two-line bold serif headline appears word by word on a near-black stage, each word shrinking from 1.3x into place, with one word in red or gold italic.

skills.code_name: Eio fill bar with floor-stepped counter
skills.summary: A frosted pill under a window counts "Step 1 of 7" up to "Step 7 of 7" while its indigo bar fills, as the screens inside the window cut through the steps, ending on a click and a "live" chip.
Two lines of giant white Rye type crash down from 1.8x onto a warm photo, shaking sideways for 0.8s with a red glow.

skills.code_name: Three skewed bars sweeping across with eio5 stagger
skills.summary: Three tall indigo bars, skewed 18 degrees, sweep across the frame one behind another and the scene changes behind them.
A flat purple gradient panel sweeps left to right across the whole frame in 0.45 seconds, and the next page scales up from 92 percent behind it as the panel leaves.

skills.code_name: Radial-gradient vignette with a hand-drawn note
skills.summary: A white profile card in a swaying dark spotlight on black, with a yellow handwritten 'Forever?' wiping on, a wavy underline drawing itself, and a bold white 'Forever.' popping up.
A post card bursts in from huge and slightly rotated, and a heavy uppercase word with a blue block stamps over it, changing word to word.

skills.visual_name: Stat card row with count-up numbers
skills.code_name: Staggered card rise, eased integer count
skills.summary: Four frosted white stat cards rise in one after another while their big numbers count up and end in an indigo +.

skills.visual_name: Stat cards lifting out of a window
skills.summary: Three stat cards separate from the bottom of a product window one after another and spring toward the viewer.

skills.code_name: Preserve-3d grid with staggered translateZ and drift
skills.summary: A 4 by 4 wall of tall video posters tilted in 3D, each tile flying in from far behind in a diagonal ripple, while the whole wall drifts upward.

skills.code_name: Pulsing dot, drawn leader line and label pill
skills.summary: A ringed dot lands on a real part of a screen, a line draws out from it, and a dark label pill fades in at the line end, one callout per spoken word.

skills.code_name: Substring slice with a blinking caret
skills.summary: A rounded glass pill with a lock icon types a web address letter by letter with a blinking caret that keeps blinking after the last character.
A dark pill with a green check and the words Good to go pops up in the corner of a result screen with a springy overshoot.

skills.visual_name: Violet AI review dashboard with counting score ring
skills.code_name: Counting ring, rising bars, glowing brain, push-in camera
skills.summary: A dark violet dashboard with a glowing brain, a score ring counting up to about 85 and rising glowing bars, under a slow push-in and pull-back.

skills.code_name: Max of minimum and voice length
skills.summary: Eight scene blocks and their voice lines stretch and shrink as the narrator changes, with the total length shown above.
A glass panel slides up with seven weekday cells, and coloured square dots pop into each one left to right.

skills.visual_name: Whip pan with directional motion blur
skills.code_name: SVG gaussian blur on one axis
skills.summary: Full-frame windows whip in and out: one flies up from below smeared vertically, exits sideways to the left smeared horizontally, and the next arrives from the right, each blur fading as the move settles.
A one-line sentence appears one word at a time, each word rising out of a light blur, with a gradient bold phrase and a small app notification card placed inline as words.

skills.code_name: Clip-path inset wipe, then shrink and rise
skills.summary: A wordmark is revealed from left to right by a hard clip edge on the spoken name, then shrinks to 42% and rises out of frame to make way for the next scene.

skills.code_name: Spring scale-down, camera shake and expanding ring
skills.summary: A big logo drops in from 150% size out of a blur, the frame jolts, a ring expands outward, a shine crosses the letters, then the logo shrinks into the top-left corner.

skills.visual_name: Accordion listing row with copy fields
skills.summary: A list of white rows; one opens to a panel of labelled fields, each with a Copy button that flashes solid green, plus platform toggle pills and a toast.
Switch rows for included features and add-ons with a spring knob, and a price whose changed digits roll up and out.

skills.code_name: Float, aura and blink by status
skills.summary: Eight small SVG creatures in a row on a glass stage, one running at a time with pulsing rings and a bobbing smile, finished ones settling with a check badge, pending ones dimmed, plus a status line underneath that swaps text as the run advances.

A slim near-black dock pinned to the bottom with an avatar, a name and a live status line, and two keyboard-shortcut buttons; pressing Chat grows a text composer upward out of the bar while the status line swaps with a small slide.
A segmented audience toggle in the nav that fades the hero copy out and a new audience in, and changes the URL.
A result card with a counting percent badge, two growing before/after bars and a drag-to-compare report slider.
Near-black glass cards with a lit chrome top edge, a diagonal sheen and a short bright arc of light that circles each card's border at a different phase.
A floating glass dock of icon buttons that swell toward the pointer on springs, with a tooltip above the button under the pointer and a dot under the active one.

skills.code_name: Fresnel shader, scan plane and zaps
skills.summary: A translucent violet 3D brain that auto-rotates and swings to face whatever region is being read, regions glowing in their own colours and pulsing, a cyan scan plane sweeping through, electric arcs and sparks jumping between active regions, and a chat bubble pinned to the focus.
Two rows of client logos drifting in opposite directions at slightly different speeds, with wordmarks and icon-plus-name logos mixed, faded out at both edges.

A dark command palette that drops in from above, its rows fading up one after another; typing swaps the search icon for a send icon with a vertical slide and narrows the list, with a purple selected row and a hint footer.

A big monospace timer where each digit that changes slides up out of its slot while the next one slides in from below, with a pulsing clock icon, a green Running label and a thin bar draining underneath.

A low-poly three.js island with a tiki hut, lab building, dance floor and palms, where a sun and moon arc across the sky, the sky colour lerps through sunset to a starry night, torches and spotlights come on, and box-bodied agents wander with chat bubbles.
A flat logo turned into a solid slab by stacking 18 copies 1.6px apart in 3D, with bright front and back faces and darkened inner slices, turning a full 360 on a slight tilt.
A single-open FAQ in a glass rounded card with hairline dividers; answers slide open to auto height and fade in.

skills.visual_name: Floating phone hero with credential marquee
skills.summary: A cream landing hero with a big sans headline and one italic serif accent word, beside a phone mockup that floats and tilts gently on a 7 second loop, with a scrolling credentials strip along the bottom.
Two counter-scrolling rows of floating glass cards holding payment and analytics screenshots of different sizes.
A portrait card with five frosted-glass stat tiles tilted in 3D, bobbing out of phase, numbers counting up, photos crossfading.
A frosted glass folder with a tabbed front pocket that pops in on scroll; hover fans three app-icon tiles up out of it, hovering a tile lifts it with a name pill and lights its tag.
A floating pill nav that fades from transparent to frosted glass after 12px of scroll, with a glass dropdown menu on mobile.

A landing hero that builds itself in order: headline, paragraph, buttons and a video card each rise 20 to 32px and fade in on the same expo-out curve, 0.1s apart, with a gradient second line in the headline.

A progress card where an AI reviewer texts what it is doing: a grey iOS-style bubble pops in from its corner with three bouncing typing dots, swaps to the message, and finished steps stay behind as check-marked bubbles.
A mobile link-in-bio with an avatar header, stat tiles and grouped glass link rows that fade up one after another.
A black glass button inside a brushed-silver chrome rim, with small gold, blue and violet glints that keep travelling round the edge.
A slow endless row of brand logos with soft edge fades, each logo drifting up and down out of phase.
Two small 3D logo loops side by side: a round monogram coin that spins a full 360 degrees on its vertical axis every 6 seconds, and a wordmark that swings between -35 and 35 degrees every 4 seconds.

skills.visual_name: Multiplier stat chain and rule cards
skills.summary: Five stat cards joined by arrows fade up in order with counting numbers, then three cards draw an accent rule along their top edge.

A dark low-poly three.js city grid at night: dozens of skyscrapers with lit window patterns and blinking red antenna tips, a taller dark-glass tower with a lit sign and a glow that runs up its blue accent lines, glowing street lamps and taxis driving the avenues, under stars.

skills.visual_name: Numbered card grid and dark steps panel
skills.summary: A scroll-triggered sequence: glass cards numbered 01 to 06 stagger in, then a dark rounded steps panel reveals.
A big green figure whose digit columns roll upward through two full cycles and settle left to right, with three smaller counters beside it.
A black hero with a 152px name over a ring of ten tall video cards turning in 3D; hover pauses it.
A chrome wordmark floating on a breathing glow that dwells facing forward, sweeps through 180 degrees to its back face, dwells again, and swings home, always reading the right way round.

A flat white wordmark on a three.js plane swings on its vertical axis like a pendulum through a full half turn each way, flipping its mirror at the edge-on moment so it always reads correctly, over a faint round glow.
A ball bounces down a peg board with real physics into a discount pocket, which glows gold under a confetti burst.
Two rows of 9:16 video cards in glass frames scrolling in opposite directions, each with a niche pill, a creator name and a bottom shade, faded at the edges.
A black receipt-printer machine prints a monospace slip with a torn zigzag edge and barcode; Pay now flips it to paid.
A step wizard with chip-style progress, a glass form card and a side preview that updates live with typing and theme choices.
A page heading in white with a soft lilac highlight that sweeps across the letters once, then rests for four seconds before sweeping again, under a small violet eyebrow.

A low-poly three.js winter scene: a warm-lit log cabin with a pillared porch among snow-capped pines, ski chairs gliding along a cable, a steaming geyser and hot spring, and two thousand snow flakes falling in the haze.

The page dims to 78% black with a rounded hole cut around one element; the hole springs to the next target on each step, with a violet outline and a tooltip card that places itself beside it and counts the steps.
Four centred glass stat tiles that rise one after another while their numbers count up.

skills.visual_name: Sticky command bar with live stats
skills.summary: A sticky top bar holding a title, three right-aligned stat blocks, a save-state pill and a thin progress rail that fills as work gets done.
An autoplaying muted video in a glass frame with a frosted "Tap for sound" pill and a pulsing ring; tapping restarts it with sound.

A vertical hairline with a dot per item and a frosted glass card beside each; the cards rise in one after another on scroll, and clicking one opens its detail with a height and fade animation while the dot turns blue and the chevron flips.
Two counter-scrolling rows of vertical video cards with niche chips; click opens a spring-up glass player sheet.

The page records every click, key and whoosh with its time as it plays; a script turns that list into a finished sound track.

A speech-to-text pass gives the start time of every word; each scene cut is that time minus a small lead, and the sounds follow.

skills.visual_name: Groove drop-out for a joke beat
skills.code_name: Single pluck for a joke beat
skills.summary: The full groove stops dead on a cut, leaving one quiet pluck per bar and two low pops on the punchlines, then an impact and a soft pad take over for the end card.
A slower, heavier bed in D minor at 104 BPM: a saw pad, a quiet 16th-note arp, a half-time kick and clap, and a slow sidechain dip.
Twenty-eight tiny high ticks 28 ms apart, cycling through four pitches, matching a number that counts up fast.
A four-on-the-floor drum loop with a thumping sine kick, noisy claps on 2 and 4, and open and closed hi-hats, all synthesised.
A soft A-minor drone of four sine waves that fade in and out, with a second pad that wobbles in phase, for under a voiceover.
The music drops about 6 dB while a voice is speaking and comes back in the gaps, by following the voice's loudness.
A tiny bubble-pop made from a sine that drops in pitch, used one per word, in rising steps, in rows or as a spread.
Two seconds of rising band-passed noise that cuts off on the downbeat, where a sine boom with an air tail hits.
Offbeat bass, plucks and hats that duck with every kick, so the whole bed pumps.
One key click per typed character, timed from the same ease-in-out curve that reveals the text on screen.
Each narration line is rendered, measured, and re-rendered faster if it runs past its slot, up to 1.35x.
A short airy sweep of band-passed noise that peaks on a hard cut, with variants for a scroll, a downward sweep and a wipe.
